t: This is 23 Cavendish Close, a building in Westminster, in north-west London. It matters because of Myra Hess, the pianist, who died here. Dame Myra Hess was known for her performances of Bach, Mozart, Beethoven, Schumann and Brahms. She is also remembered for organising concerts in London during the Second World War and the Blitz, keeping music going through a very difficult time. It's a quiet spot, and worth pausing for a moment to think of her.
